notes.title: Comando Rio will be a separate game
notes.content:
[h3][b]!!! ATTENTION!!![/b][/h3]

In order to accelerate development and mainly start monetizing the project, I decided to separate [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830910/Comando_Rio/]Comando Rio[/url][/b] from [b]AfterImpaKt[/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830910/Comando_Rio/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2830910/extras/library_logo_transparent.png?t=1709080285 [/img][/url]

I recently left my day job, where I capitalized to finance my games. Therefore, I need money coming in as quickly as possible to cover the costs of the game.

It doesn't make sense to start campaigns about [b]AfterImpaKt[/b] knowing that it would need to have at least a few Worlds working to justify the start of sales, and above all to be honest with my players. As it is a very big and bold project for one person to do alone, this would take a long time, so I decided to separate them into two projects.

[previewyoutube=0PW_GfLAWT4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830910/Comando_Rio/]Comando Rio[/url][/b] will be simpler and faster to develop, and will be the first step towards creation from [b]AfterImpaKt[/b] in the future. In addition to taking advantage of the [b]Call of Duty Rio[/b] Hype and player base.

Also with the money earned at [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830910/Comando_Rio/]Comando Rio[/url][/b], I will be able to work even better at [b]AfterImpaKt[/b], because in none of the projects I want to release something desperately rushed just to start receiving, this will not happen as it is against my principles.

It may even be that in the distant future, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830910/Comando_Rio/]Comando Rio[/url][/b] will be incorporated again into [b]AfterImpaKt[/b], which has as its premise several completely different FPS games that merge over time, so nothing will stop us from having to face [ b]Aliens [/b]or [b]Zombies [/b]in the favelas of Rio further on.

With this, [b]AfterImpaKt [/b]will be on standby until [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830910/Comando_Rio/]Comando Rio[/url][/b] grow enough to finance the big and final project of my life, which is [b]AfterImpaKt[/b].

I hope you understand why, and thank you to everyone who is eager to start playing my new creations.
